project vesting liquidityShares = mulDiv(liquidity, projectConfig.shares, BPS) using FULL liquidity; possible over-allocation > deployed liquidity if shares validation insufficient

liquidity over-allocation depends on _validateSharesAndVests (not in surface)

rejected_mechanisms: SALE_TOKEN refund balance-based (separate token, by design)
